## Import from your database
**File → Import from database.** Pick your dialect, copy the read-only query drawDB gives you, run it in the SQL client you already use (psql, Workbench, DBeaver, SSMS…), and paste the result back. drawDB draws the diagram and auto-arranges it.
- Works with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite and Oracle
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/drawdb-io/drawdb/compare/v

## Bug Fixes
* Applies the configured release rules for breaking changes, preventing version-16 releases from being incorrectly assigned a major-version number. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44914)
* Checks access permissions when the _File URL_ on a **File** changes, preventing users from linking to files they cannot access. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44347)
* Fixes blank pages when opening query reports whose names contain apostrophes. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44497)

### 误删保护

- 删除任务后提供十秒快捷撤销；管理窗口新增“最近删除”，七天内可恢复，过期后自动清理。
- 删除期间保留原始任务字段与提醒配置，但退出待办统计、编辑和提醒队列；关闭相关未确认弹窗。
- 恢复保留未来提醒和历史去重记录，不补发已过去的通知。删除、恢复与整轮调度互斥，后台等待不阻塞窗口线程。
- 数据库升级至 v6，迁移前在线备份；支持恢复 v4 / v

### 导航与提醒操作

- 悬浮窗与托盘中的“设置”直接进入管理窗口的设置页；导航请求缓存到前端接收并确认，避免首次打开窗口时漏掉跳转。
- 提醒卡片新增单条“完成任务”“稍后 5 / 10 分钟”“查看详情”，保留批量稍后和确认操作。
- 查看详情打开对应任务编辑页，成功请求打开后仅确认该条提醒；不会把任务标记为完成，窗口正在编辑其他内容时保留草稿，待编辑关闭后
- Native QA instance: language selected through Settings, persisted to SQLite, and restored in English after restart.
